$comment: Permissions for Feature Loop Protocol ticks run headlessly by .loop/drive.sh.
A `claude -p` tick cannot answer a permission prompt: it stalls, emits no
TICK-RESULT, and the driver scores it as a silent orchestrator. Every command
/loop needs must therefore be pre-authorised here.
Read and workflow commands are allowed. The state-changing ones a human should
still own are listed under `ask` — notably `gh pr merge`. Turn that into an
`allow` entry only when the blast-radius auto-merge policy in loop.md has been
observed REFUSING a merge at least once; a policy that has never said no is not
known to work, and until then auto-merge is an untested gate with commit rights.
